clue.text: What might commemorate a serious Mick Jagger?

parts.note: grave means serious or solemn

explanation.walkthrough: The 'a' is taken with 'serious' in the surface; cryptically it simply sits in the definition's phrasing.
explanation.definitionFit: A headstone over a grave bears the name of the dead person and so serves as a memorial.

clue.text: Occasion when everything goes wrong in Barnet?

definitions.text: Occasion when everything goes wrong in Barnet?

parts.words: Occasion when everything goes wrong in Barnet?
